CustomField.description: Admission Year preselected in the "Sync Leads to Salesforce" popup, e.g. Admission Year - 2027. Must be an active Lead Admission Year value; blank or invalid = the Lead picklist default is used. Change it at the start of each admission cycle. (Since 2026-11-05 no longer written to new sessions.)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Year preselected in Sync Leads to Salesforce, e.g. Admission Year - 2027.
CustomField.label: Default Admission Year
